lines.text: Who's asking?
Does he think I can't see him? The tree is thin.
'IDK' was my idea. After the trials. My whole team says it.
I'm waiting to see how long he carries it.
Tell him six o'clock. And I know my own name.
(It's going well. Watch the film.)
Wear mine.
It beat Law, Science and Agriculture this term.
What has yours beaten?
He did. He didn't notice. Don't tell him.
Three times. I wrote it in MY diary.
Where was the training?
Who's asking? …I am. Every week. Where you were.
Who's asking? Leave it blank.
Pain?
Pain?
Who's asking?
Who's asking?
Who's asking?
Hello. Are you walking on that ankle or dragging it?
Oh, it's you. Jega's messenger. What's the message today?
Good morning. Shoulders back. Was that so hard?
Go. Stretch first. You won't, but go.
Bye. Tell nobody you saw me. They'll ask my name.
Thank you. That was kind. Was it on purpose?
Sorry. Did that hurt? Don't lie, I'm a physio.
Good posture today. Did somebody tell you, or did you grow?
That serve was nearly decent. Who taught you? Not Jega.
You walk like your bag is full of textbooks. Is it? Or garri?
Do you know your hamstrings exist? They know you exist.
I'm coming. Slowly. Do you know what rushing does to a knee?
Are you coming, or shall I book you an appointment?
Is this the physio wing? No. Is that a problem? Yes.
Yes. Was there any doubt?
No. Was that the answer you wanted?
Maybe. Who's asking?
What is he trying to say? Does he know?
Who? There was nobody there fa. Are you sleeping enough?
Exactly. Why didn't I say that? I did.
No. Did you think a smile would work? It nearly did. No.
What's my name? IDK. Why does everyone laugh? I laugh too.
Pain? Out of ten? Be honest. Jega says four when it's nine.
We won. Did you see the block? Of course you did. Everybody did.
We lost. Did we learn? We'll find out on Thursday.
Did you just walk into me? Was the Love Garden bench in the way?
Sit. Breathe. Does anything feel wrong? No? Then up.
Light's gone. Do you need to see to stretch? You don't.
Light. Shall we pretend we were reading?
Rain. Volleyball's off. Who's sad? Not me.
Water. Now. Do you want cramp in Theatre Gabas?
Fried yam again? Is that a meal or a decision?
Do you know what a physio costs in town? Do you know what I charge Jega? Nothing.
For me? What's the occasion? …Do I need one? No. Thank you.
Flowers from the gate? Did Jega send you? Tell him I know.
Roasted corn. Hot. How did you know? Did someone tell you? Thank you.
Rotate. Hold. Release. Why does nobody hold?
IDK. My whole team says it now. Do they know why? Does it matter?
Late training? Ice, not heat. Who taught you heat?
Six o'clock. I knew my own name. He nearly didn't.
The tree was very thin. Did he think I couldn't see him?
You're the one carrying his messages? Is he paying you?
Is that the footballer staring? Does he think the tree is a wall?
He told his friends 'IDK'. I told my team. Who's winning?
What does he want? Does he know what he wants?
Wrong flowers. Did you choose them, or did they choose you?
The cinema. He talked through all of it. Was it a film? I don't know.
You listened first. Did you know most people don't?
Volleyball court's flooded. Shall we train in the corridor? Yes.
You again. Is Jega's sock found yet?
It beat Law, Science and Agriculture this term. What has your faculty beaten?
A goat ate his lucky sock. Did anyone take the goat's statement? Bilkisu did.
He played in one sock and scored twice. Don't tell him I cried.
Three times he forgot. I wrote it in MY diary. Do you keep one?
Jega says I'm his good luck. Did he ask me first? He did not.
He bought me a bag of corn. Is that romance? It was warm.
You're good at the quiet bits. Did you know that?
Walk with me to the volleyball court? Will you carry the net? Thank you.
Where's he? You know? Will you tell me, or will he?
Training. In town. On a ploughed field. Was it training?
Who's asking? I am. Every week. Where you were.
Where was the training? He told the truth in the end. That's all I asked.
I walked away from the TH. Did I want to? No. Did I need to? Yes.
Has he eaten today? Has he slept? Has he lied?
You're his conscience? How's that going?
Strike heat. No fans. Do you know how many students faint? I do.
You stayed with him at the TH. Did you know I knew?
Six o'clock. Rehab. Who's late? You. Who's surprised? Nobody.
Excuses column. Do not fill. Has he filled it? Twice. In pen.
Pain? Swelling? Did he skip the pool? He skipped the pool.
Bolaji does the exercises too. Does he need them? He insists.
You found him on the empty pitch. Did you fix it? You sat. That fixes more.
Wrong foot! Did you see his face? Like the ball betrayed his family!
Twenty minutes, cleared. Who's counting? Me. And Coach. And the knee.
Pool next. Can you swim? Can you pretend?
If he lands on that knee, who's running onto the pitch? Me. Then Zainab.
Final year. Do you know what you're doing? Does anyone?
Contract talk. Is he nervous? He's polishing the left boot. Yes.
Who's asking? He said it on the microphone. Five years. He finally asked.
He signed. Did he call me first? He did. I said, who's asking?
You've grown up. Did it hurt? It usually does.
My name? Are you still asking? It's on the dinner card.
After convocation, where will you go? Will you write? Who's asking? I am.
Are you stretching before the procession? It's a long walk in a gown.
Freshers asking my name. Shall I tell them? IDK.
Anatomy. Two hundred and six bones. Can you name ten? Start with the knee.
Results? I passed. Were you worried? Was he?
Allowance came. He bought new boots. Did he need them? Who's asking?
Market day. Will he buy me corn? Will he forget his wallet? Both.
Strike. No lectures. Will the volleyball team stop? Who's asking?
Who am I voting for? Who's asking? …Nusaiba. Obviously.
Gown, cap, his left boot first. Some things don't change. Why would they?
Iftar on the mosque grounds? I'll bring the water. Who's carrying the coolers?
Christmas break. Who's travelling? Take a pillow for the bus. Your neck will thank me.
Harmattan. Cracked lips, cracked heels, cracked excuses. Moisturise.
